68a55cb6b0c760220d45f885.name: Toyota TEQ Logo
68a55cb6b0c760220d45f885.blurb: TEQ is "To-yo-ta" spelled in Katakana, one of the Japanese phonetic alphabets. It was used as the Toyota logo starting in 1936 at the time when Toyoda Automatic Loom Works Ltd. launched its first car.

68a55cb6b868b07c0575ef83.name: Miata is always the answer
68a55cb6b868b07c0575ef83.blurb: It really is always the answer. Track Day Car? Miata. Beginner autocross car? Miata. Great fun daily driver? Miata. You simply can't go wrong with the car.. or this design. 2 Color vector design.

5d89f20f13615160bf833e7d.name: Save the Stick - Bones
5d89f20f13615160bf833e7d.blurb: Manual transmissions are dying. Help save the world from flappy paddles and slushboxes. SAVE THE STICK!

5d89f19b1cbf3a25d5a8b50e.name: Datsun 510
5d89f19b1cbf3a25d5a8b50e.blurb: The Datsun 1600 PL510 first hit the streets in 1968. In just a short few years it would stake its claim to road and street racing glory.

5d89f20e2051762642224541.name: AE86 Corolla Coupe
5d89f20e2051762642224541.blurb: The unsung hero of the 80s, the AE86 chassis Corolla GT-S Trueno/Levin is a true classic. Its light weight and rear wheel drive have made it great for road racing, autocross, rally and drifting.

5d89f19b13615160bf82f7a6.name: Petrol Sexual
5d89f19b13615160bf82f7a6.blurb: You bleed 5W-30... and it stains your clothes. This is for you. You sweat 91 Octane... and everyone can smell it. This is for you. You've always been a Petrolsexual.. now show everyone.

5d89f1ce162c5f464e8776be.name: Volvo Brick Driver
5d89f1ce162c5f464e8776be.blurb: So sayeth Hewy Lewis and so it shall be.. It's hip to be square. Volvo drivers have known this for years and now they can show their brick driving pride.

5d89f19a13615160bf82f7a2.name: Lucky Smells Lumber MIll
5d89f19a13615160bf82f7a2.blurb: Lucky Smells is our life. Lucky Smells is our home.

68a55cb6b868b07c0575ef91.name: Mazda Rotary - Iron Man
68a55cb6b868b07c0575ef91.blurb: It turns out that Tony Stark's top secret generator was just a Mazda Wankel Rotary. Who knew? YOU DID! You'll always know when Iron Man is coming when you hear that familiar brap, brap, brap.

5d89f20e162c5f464e8791ce.sourceName: Save the Stick - Red Cross - 5 Speed
5d89f20e162c5f464e8791ce.name: Save the Stick - Red Cross - 5 Speed
5d89f20e162c5f464e8791ce.blurb: For too long the tyranny of the sequential gearbox has threatened to take from us, the driving community, our rights and freedoms. Save driving, save the stick!

68a55cb63f6bcc7d6db21930.name: I Void Car Warranties
68a55cb63f6bcc7d6db21930.blurb: Don't we all? Even a simple wheel change can get your warranty swiped out from under you these days. Mostly the reason why I will never buy another new car... but I digress.

5d89f1f8f937647d8113f389.name: Petrol Sexual
5d89f1f8f937647d8113f389.blurb: You bleed 5W-30... and it stains your clothes. This shirt is for you. You sweat 91 Octane... and everyone can smell it. This shirt is for you. "Piston" by Proletkult Graphik, from The Noun Project

5d89f19c6bbdbb2e6a5b1ea8.name: Save the Stick - Shift Pattern
5d89f19c6bbdbb2e6a5b1ea8.blurb: Before the manual transmission goes the way of the dodo.. show your support for real driving.

5d89f1e06bbdbb2e6a5b4eb0.name: Toyota Tosco Brochure Art
5d89f1e06bbdbb2e6a5b4eb0.blurb: This shirt features several parts from an early 70s Toyota Tosco brochure for TA22 Celica 1600GT road and rally racing parts

5d89f1f71cbf3a25d5a8e59d.name: S Generations
5d89f1f71cbf3a25d5a8e59d.blurb: The same as our other s800/s2000 design but without the crusty stuff at the bottom so it can be placed low on a shirt.

5d89f1cd205176264222294a.name: Toyota Tosco Logo
5d89f1cd205176264222294a.blurb: Before becoming Toyota Racing Development, TRD was known as Toyota Sports Corner, or TOSCO. TOSCO was established in Yokohama and built Toyota's first performance engines for the Celica and Corolla.

5d89f1cd13615160bf831625.name: That's What Speed Do
5d89f1cd13615160bf831625.blurb: Gore, Dyson, Escobar, Cain. We've got the need... the need... for speed.

5d89f1b51cbf3a25d5a8c6f8.name: Toyota Corolla KE70
5d89f1b51cbf3a25d5a8c6f8.blurb: One word, tossable. That pretty much sums up the experience of driving a KE70. The early 80s was a good time for Toyota .

5d89f20e162c5f464e8791cc.name: S Generations
5d89f20e162c5f464e8791cc.blurb: Light, low, high compression, high revs. Same principles of great sports cars.. made 40 years apart. The S800 and S2000 stand as the benchmarks of Japanese sports cars.

5d89f1f813615160bf83367f.name: Toyota Celica Cutaway
5d89f1f813615160bf83367f.blurb: This particular graphic comes from a JDM Celica brochure for the 1600GT with a 2TG motor.

5d89f20e20517626422245b0.name: AE86 Corolla Hatchback
5d89f20e20517626422245b0.blurb: The unsung hero of the 80s, the AE86 chassis Corolla GT-S Trueno/Levin is a true classic. Its light weight and rear wheel drive have made it great for road racing, autocross, rally and drifting.

5d89f1f71cbf3a25d5a8e5c1.name: Aschwanden Spark Plug
5d89f1f71cbf3a25d5a8e5c1.blurb: Peter Aschwanden was best known for illustrating John Muir’s How to Keep Your Volkswagen Alive: A Manual of Step-by-Step Procedures for the Compleat Idiot.
